minutes.headline: Board approved a cat shelter's expansion and set a Sept. 22 hearing on MBTA Communities zoning
minutes.summary: The Planning Board approved a site plan for an addition to the Pat Brody shelter for cats at 499 Northfield Road and extended the review period on an ANR lot-line application at 830 Massachusetts Ave to clarify a dimensional-regulations question. The chair reported progress toward a September 22 public hearing on MBTA Communities zoning, a coming land use director/planner job posting, and warned the public about fraudulent invoices sent on town letterhead; the board also fixed a paperwork error on a performance guarantee account and nominated a new member to the Municipal Building Design Committee.

votes.motion: Nominate Matt Brener as the planning board's designator to the Municipal Building Design Committee
Close the public hearing for 499 Northfield Road (Pat Brody shelter for cats site plan)
Approve the site plan for 499 Northfield Road with all standard conditions plus a special condition requiring submission of an operation and maintenance plan for the storm water drip edge
Close out the current performance guarantee account for 430 Mulpus Road, turn funds over to the town treasurer, and open a new correctly-formatted performance guarantee account
Approve the minutes from the July 14 meeting

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the job posting is being changed to focus exclusively on planning and economic development, with the building-management component split into a separate stipend position, to make the role more competitive.

The applicant's engineer said recording an 81X plan currently costs a fee at the registry, which some property owners may consider worthwhile in the long run even though it is not required for this project.

The board voted to close an old performance guarantee (surety) account opened under outdated bank paperwork and have the town treasurer open a correctly formatted replacement account; no dollar amount was stated in the captions.
The chair noted the select board modified the committee's charge after years of the project not moving forward, and the planning board needed to name a new designee.
The chair reported the Capital Planning Committee is just beginning its annual process of getting meetings scheduled again, with nothing yet to report.
A board member urged submitting a warrant article placeholder soon so a deadline for the fall town meeting is not missed while the town lacks a full-time planner.

transfers.description: Close out the old 430 Mulpus Road Performance Guarantee account (opened under an outdated bank account format) and transfer its funds to the town treasurer to establish a new, correctly formatted performance guarantee account for the same surety deposit

decisions.decision: Applicant for the 830 Massachusetts Ave ANR agreed to extend the board's 21-day statutory review period to the September 8 meeting so a dimensional lot-width/lot-area question could be clarified, rather than the board denying and requiring refiling.
The board agreed to carry review of the Master Plan Steering Committee's draft goals/recommendations relevant to the planning board to the first meeting in September, to give members time to read it.
The master plan review item will also be placed on the following meeting's discussion agenda, giving the board two meetings to review it before the end-of-September deadline.
The board will not re-discuss the previously-declined West Townsend Road-area open space parcel unless time allows at a future meeting, since other committees had already said no to picking it up.
The chair's goal is to hold the MBTA Communities zoning public hearing at the September 22 meeting, contingent on the consultant delivering the finalized bylaw language in time.

what_happened.line: The board approved a site plan for an addition to the Pat Brody cat shelter at 499 Northfield Road, conditioned on a stormwater maintenance plan.
The chair set a goal of holding a public hearing on MBTA Communities zoning compliance on September 22, contingent on the consultant finishing bylaw language in time.
The board extended review of a lot-line application at 830 Massachusetts Ave to September 8 to clarify a dimensional question rather than denying it outright.
The board closed an incorrectly opened performance guarantee account for 430 Mulpus Road and had the town treasurer open a properly formatted replacement.
The chair warned applicants about fraudulent invoices being sent out on town letterhead.

why_it_matters: MBTA Communities zoning compliance sets what housing the town's bylaw must allow, and the September 22 hearing is the next public chance to weigh in before any change reaches town meeting.
The cat shelter approval and the Mulpus Road account correction are routine permitting and finance actions that keep an active local project and a town-held fund properly documented.
Anyone doing business with the town who receives an invoice on town letterhead should confirm it directly with the town before paying.
